payload.tension: The passage states barnabas and Saul return with John Mark. But the word of God grew and multiplied. Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
